summary: The old harness can reach spoiler rendering: fuzz input controls the parser flags and Markdown passed to md_html. This focused candidate does not require a harness update.

claims.necessity_reason: A finite input can set MD_FLAG_SPOILERS in the first unsigned flag word and place paired || delimiters in the remaining Markdown bytes. The existing entry passes both to md_html, and the supplied after-source call path reaches spoiler resolution and HTML rendering.

before.reason: The complete before span enum has no spoiler type, and the before mark collector handles pipes only for tables or wiki links.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before collector has only the table and wiki-link pipe handler.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS set and paired || delimiters in Markdown, recognize the spoiler span and emit x-spoiler tags.
after.reason: The entry supplies the flag and Markdown to md_html. The parser collects and pairs double-pipe marks in ordinary inline text, dispatches spoiler span callbacks, and the HTML callbacks emit both tags.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: md_html places the supplied flags in MD_PARSER and calls md_parse with the supplied Markdown.
Ordinary leaf blocks reach normal block contents.
Normal block contents analyzes and processes inline marks.
The spoiler flag enables pipe mark collection.
The collector records adjacent pipes as a two-character delimiter mark.
Ordinary inline analysis sends unresolved double-pipe marks to spoiler analysis.
The pipe analyzer pairs and resolves opener and closer marks.
Resolved double-pipe marks dispatch spoiler span callbacks.
The HTML opening callback emits the spoiler tag.
The HTML closing callback emits the matching tag.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe compiles the entry and links the HTML renderer and parser libraries.

claims.comparison_reason: The frozen spoiler-rendering behavior was unavailable before the change and is reachable through the same old harness afterward. Coverage remains incomplete because this assessment is limited to the supplied focus candidate.
